title: Fix admin dashboard to display and edit all features

requirements.text: Fix the AdminPage component to properly fetch and display all 27 Nakshatras from the backend using the useNakshatrasQuery hook, ensuring the grid renders with edit buttons for each Nakshatra

quotes: the dashboard is not working. please fix it so i can edit all the features

acceptanceCriteria: AdminPage successfully fetches all 27 Nakshatras from backend
All Nakshatras display in the grid layout with their images
Each Nakshatra card shows an edit button that links to the AdminEditPage
Loading and error states display appropriately

requirements.text: Verify the AdminEditPage properly loads individual Nakshatra data and all form fields (image upload, ruling deity, symbol, description, characteristics) are functional for editing

quotes: please fix it so i can edit all the features

acceptanceCriteria: AdminEditPage successfully fetches single Nakshatra data by name
All form fields populate with existing Nakshatra data
Image upload component works with 4:5 aspect ratio validation
Save functionality successfully updates backend data
Success/error toast notifications display after save attempts

requirements.text: Ensure the backend getAllNakshatras and getNakshatra query methods are working correctly and returning the complete data structure including name, imageUrl, description, rulingDeity, symbol, and characteristics

quotes: the admin dashboard is not displaying any nakshatras to edit

acceptanceCriteria: getAllNakshatras returns all 27 Nakshatras with complete data
getNakshatra correctly retrieves individual Nakshatra by name
All Nakshatra properties are properly serialized in responses
Backend queries handle missing data gracefully

requirements.text: Debug and fix any React Query hooks (useNakshatrasQuery, useNakshatraQuery) to ensure proper actor integration and data fetching from the backend
acceptanceCriteria: useNakshatrasQuery successfully calls backend and returns data
useNakshatraQuery works with Nakshatra name parameter
Query hooks properly handle loading and error states
Actor dependency is correctly managed in query keys

constraints: Preserve existing Motoko backend data structure with all 27 hardcoded Nakshatras
Maintain 4:5 aspect ratio requirement for Nakshatra images
Keep existing Layout, Header, and Footer components unchanged
Do not modify Internet Identity authentication implementation
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond fixing the existing admin dashboard
Redesigning the admin interface layout or styling
Changing the Nakshatra data model or adding new fields
Implementing user role management or access control
